- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Baclaran Market offers a wide variety of local food options.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular dishes at Baclaran Market include:
  1. Taho - a snack made with soft tofu, brown sugar syrup, and tapioca pearls.
  2. Lechon - a roasted pig that is a staple dish at Filipino celebrations.
  3. Halo-halo - a dessert made with shaved ice, evaporated milk, sweetened beans, fruits, and jellies.
  4. Lumpia - a Filipino-style spring roll served fried or fresh.
  5. Adobo - a dish made with chicken or pork marinated in vinegar, soy sauce, and spices.
